title: Java 21 Essentials
description: Master modern Java (Java 17/21) for backend services, Android, and enterprise systems. Learn types, switch expressions, records, interfaces, generics, collections, and Streams.
outcomes: Write clean Java 21 programs with strong types, var, and text blocks
Use modern switch expressions, methods, and exception handling
Model immutable domain data concisely with Java records and classes
Design extensible APIs using interfaces and type-safe generics
Transform data declaratively with List, Map, Optional, and the Streams API
